findings.title: S4: 'told apart by that' does not hold for a story unit's cursor-less mirror, refine-finished or move commits
findings.detail:
decide/story.ts:226, 309 and 347 pass `?.step ?? null` and no slice. A story unit's commit of that kind made before it starts carries neither Norn-Step nor Norn-Slice, so isIntakeCommit (policy.ts:184; used at git-facts.ts:70 and reset.ts:32) matches it too. The sentence states R3.1's intended rule, and this is the pre-existing code gap already routed to the person, so it is not blocking.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: In the follow-up, either give those commits a stand-in Norn-Step or add a marker isIntakeCommit can check. Until then, say in S4 that a story unit's cursor-less commits share the intake commit's trailers.

findings.title: S4: the merge after a rejected push from act.commit does not carry fewer trailers
findings.detail:
act.commit passes the full trailers of the commit it pushes (env.ts:169 -> 191 -> 214), including Norn-Step, and Norn-Outcome/Norn-Next when it ends a step. Only the git-step pushes (git-step.ts:56,109,114,124) give a Norn-Tick-only merge. 'The trailers of the push that asked for it' is true; grouping this merge under 'two commits carry fewer of these trailers' is not.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name only the git-step case under 'fewer'.

findings.detail:
